verses.original: וַיַּֽעַן־ יְהוָ֣ה אֶת־ אִ֭יּוֹב מִנ הַסְּעָרָה וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an- Yah·weh ’eṯ- ’î·yō·wḇ min has·sə·ʿå̄·rå̄h way·yō·mar
verses.literal: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind and said

verses.original: מִ֤י זֶ֨ה׀ מַחְשִׁ֖יךְ עֵצָ֥ה בְמִלִּ֗ין בְּֽלִי־ דָֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: mî zeh maḥ·šîḵ ‘ê·ṣāh ḇə·mil·lîn bə·lî- ḏā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: Who is this who obscures My counsel by words without knowledge

verses.original: אֱזָר־ נָ֣א כְגֶ֣בֶר חֲלָצֶ֑יךָ וְ֝אֶשְׁאָלְךָ֗ וְהוֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·zār- nā ḵə·ḡe·ḇer ḥă·lā·ṣe·ḵā wə·’eš·’ā·lə·ḵā wə·hō·w·ḏî·‘ê·nî
verses.literal: Now brace yourself like a man I will question you and you shall inform Me

verses.original: אֵיפֹ֣ה הָ֭יִיתָ בְּיָסְדִי־ אָ֑רֶץ הַ֝גֵּ֗ד אִם־ יָדַ֥עְתָּ בִינָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·p̄ōh hā·yî·ṯā bə·yā·sə·ḏî- ’ā·reṣ hag·gêḏ ’im- yā·ḏa‘·tā ḇî·nāh
verses.literal: Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth Tell Me if you have understanding . . .

verses.original: מִי־ שָׂ֣ם מְ֭מַדֶּיהָ כִּ֣י תֵדָ֑ע א֤וֹ מִֽי־ נָטָ֖ה עָלֶ֣יהָ קָּֽו׃
verses.transliteration: mî- śām mə·mad·de·hā kî ṯê·ḏā‘ ’ōw mî- nā·ṭāh ‘ā·le·hā qāw
verses.literal: Who fixed its measurements Surely you know Or who stretched a measuring line across it

verses.original: עַל־ מָ֭ה אֲדָנֶ֣יהָ הָטְבָּ֑עוּ א֥וֹ מִֽי־ יָ֝רָ֗ה אֶ֣בֶן פִּנָּתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- māh ’ă·ḏā·ne·hā hā·ṭə·bā·‘ū ’ōw mî- yā·rāh ’e·ḇen pin·nā·ṯāh
verses.literal: On what were its foundations set or who laid its cornerstone

verses.original: בְּרָן־ יַ֭חַד כּ֣וֹכְבֵי בֹ֑קֶר וַ֝יָּרִ֗יעוּ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: bə·rān- ya·ḥaḏ kō·wḵ·ḇê ḇō·qer way·yā·rî·‘ū kāl- bə·nê ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: while the morning stars sang together and all the sons of God shouted for joy

verses.original: וַיָּ֣סֶךְ בִּדְלָתַ֣יִם יָ֑ם בְּ֝גִיח֗וֹ מֵרֶ֥חֶם יֵצֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·seḵ biḏ·lā·ṯa·yim yām bə·ḡî·ḥōw mê·re·ḥem yê·ṣê
verses.literal: Who enclosed the sea behind doors when it burst forth from the womb . . .

verses.original: בְּשׂוּמִ֣י עָנָ֣ן לְבֻשׁ֑וֹ וַ֝עֲרָפֶ֗ל חֲתֻלָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·śū·mî ‘ā·nān lə·ḇu·šōw wa·‘ă·rā·p̄el ḥă·ṯul·lā·ṯōw
verses.literal: when I made the clouds its garment and thick darkness its blanket

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁבֹּ֣ר עָלָ֣יו חֻקִּ֑י וָֽ֝אָשִׂ֗ים בְּרִ֣יחַ וּדְלָתָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eš·bōr ‘ā·lāw ḥuq·qî wā·’ā·śîm bə·rî·aḥ ū·ḏə·lā·ṯā·yim
verses.literal: when I fixed . . . its boundaries and set in place its bars and doors

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֗ר עַד־ פֹּ֣ה תָ֭בוֹא וְלֹ֣א תֹסִ֑יף וּפֹ֥א־ יָ֝שִׁ֗ית בִּגְא֥וֹן גַּלֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ‘aḏ- pōh ṯā·ḇō·w wə·lō ṯō·sîp̄ ū·p̄ō- yā·šîṯ biḡ·’ō·wn gal·le·ḵā
verses.literal: and I declared You may come this far . . . but no farther here your proud waves must stop

verses.original: הְֽ֭מִיָּמֶיךָ צִוִּ֣יתָ בֹּ֑קֶר יִדַּעְתָּה שַׁחַר מְקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hə·mī·yå̄·mɛ·ḵå̄ ṣiw·wî·ṯā bō·qer yid·daʿ·tå̄h ša·ḥar mə·qō·mōw
verses.literal: In your days have you commanded the morning or assigned the dawn its place

verses.original: לֶ֭אֱחֹז בְּכַנְפ֣וֹת הָאָ֑רֶץ וְיִנָּעֲר֖וּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: le·’ĕ·ḥōz bə·ḵan·p̄ō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ wə·yin·nā·‘ă·rū rə·šå̄·ʿīm mim·men·nāh
verses.literal: that it might spread to the ends of the earth and shake the wicked out of it

verses.original: תִּ֭תְהַפֵּךְ כְּחֹ֣מֶר חוֹתָ֑ם וְ֝יִֽתְיַצְּב֗וּ כְּמ֣וֹ לְבֽוּשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: tiṯ·hap·pêḵ kə·ḥō·mer ḥō·w·ṯām wə·yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣə·ḇū kə·mōw lə·ḇūš
verses.literal: The earth takes shape like clay under a seal its hills stand out like the folds of a garment

verses.original: וְיִמָּנַ֣ע מֵרְשָׁעִ֣ים אוֹרָ֑ם וּזְר֥וֹעַ רָ֝מָ֗ה תִּשָּׁבֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yim·mā·na‘ mē·rə·šå̄·ʿīm ’ō·w·rām ū·zə·rō·w·a‘ rā·māh tiš·šā·ḇêr
verses.literal: Light is withheld from the wicked and their upraised arm is broken

verses.original: הֲ֭בָאתָ עַד־ נִבְכֵי־ יָ֑ם וּבְחֵ֥קֶר תְּ֝ה֗וֹם הִתְהַלָּֽכְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ḇā·ṯā ‘aḏ- niḇ·ḵê- yām ū·ḇə·ḥê·qer tə·hō·wm hiṯ·hal·lā·ḵə·tā
verses.literal: Have you journeyed to the vents of the sea or walked in the trenches of the deep

verses.original: הֲנִגְל֣וּ לְ֭ךָ שַׁעֲרֵי־ מָ֑וֶת וְשַׁעֲרֵ֖י צַלְמָ֣וֶת תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hă·niḡ·lū lə·ḵā ša·‘ă·rê- mā·weṯ wə·ša·‘ă·rê ṣal·mā·weṯ tir·’eh
verses.literal: Have the gates of death been revealed to you Have you seen the gates of the shadow of death

verses.original: הִ֭תְבֹּנַנְתָּ עַד־ רַחֲבֵי־ אָ֑רֶץ הַ֝גֵּ֗ד אִם־ יָדַ֥עְתָּ כֻלָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: hiṯ·bō·nan·tā ‘aḏ- ra·ḥă·ḇê- ’ā·reṣ hag·gêḏ ’im- yā·ḏa‘·tā ḵul·lāh
verses.literal: Have you surveyed . . . the extent of the earth Tell Me if you know all this

verses.original: אֵי־ זֶ֣ה הַ֭דֶּרֶךְ יִשְׁכָּן־ א֑וֹר וְ֝חֹ֗שֶׁךְ אֵי־ זֶ֥ה מְקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê- zeh had·de·reḵ yiš·kān- ’ō·wr wə·ḥō·šeḵ ’ê- zeh mə·qō·mōw
verses.literal: Where . . . is the way to the home of light Do you know where . . . darkness resides

verses.original: כִּ֣י תִ֭קָּחֶנּוּ אֶל־ גְּבוּל֑וֹ וְכִֽי־ תָ֝בִ֗ין נְתִיב֥וֹת בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṯiq·qā·ḥen·nū ’el- gə·ḇū·lōw wə·ḵî- ṯā·ḇîn nə·ṯî·ḇō·wṯ bê·ṯōw
verses.literal: so you can lead it back to its border . . . Do you know the paths to its home

verses.original: יָ֭דַעְתָּ כִּי־ אָ֣ז תִּוָּלֵ֑ד וּמִסְפַּ֖ר יָמֶ֣יךָ רַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḏa‘·tā kî- ’āz tiw·wā·lêḏ ū·mis·par yā·me·ḵā rab·bîm
verses.literal: Surely you know for you were already born And the number of your days is great

verses.original: הֲ֭בָאתָ אֶל־ אֹצְר֣וֹת שָׁ֑לֶג וְאֹצְר֖וֹת בָּרָ֣ד תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ḇā·ṯā ’el- ’ō·ṣə·rō·wṯ šā·leḡ wə·’ō·ṣə·rō·wṯ bā·rāḏ tir·’eh
verses.literal: Have you entered . . . the storehouses of snow or observed the storehouses of hail

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־ חָשַׂ֥כְתִּי לְעֶת־ צָ֑ר לְי֥וֹם קְ֝רָ֗ב וּמִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer- ḥā·śaḵ·tî lə·‘eṯ- ṣār lə·yō·wm qə·rāḇ ū·mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: which I hold in reserve for times of trouble for the day of war and battle

verses.original: אֵי־ זֶ֣ה הַ֭דֶּרֶךְ יֵחָ֣לֶק א֑וֹר יָפֵ֖ץ קָדִ֣ים עֲלֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê- zeh had·de·reḵ yê·ḥā·leq ’ō·wr yā·p̄êṣ qā·ḏîm ‘ă·lê- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: In which . . . direction is the lightning dispersed or the east wind scattered over the earth

verses.original: מִֽי־ פִלַּ֣ג לַשֶּׁ֣טֶף תְּעָלָ֑ה וְ֝דֶ֗רֶךְ לַחֲזִ֥יז קֹלֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: mî- p̄il·laḡ laš·še·ṭep̄ tə·‘ā·lāh wə·ḏe·reḵ la·ḥă·zîz qō·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: Who cuts a channel for the flood or clears a path for the thunderbolt

verses.original: לְ֭הַמְטִיר עַל־ אֶ֣רֶץ לֹא־ אִ֑ישׁ מִ֝דְבָּ֗ר לֹא־ אָדָ֥ם בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ham·ṭîr ‘al- ’e·reṣ lō- ’îš miḏ·bār lō- ’ā·ḏām bōw
verses.literal: to bring rain on a barren . . . land on a desert where no man lives

verses.original: לְהַשְׂבִּ֣יעַ שֹׁ֭אָה וּמְשֹׁאָ֑ה וּ֝לְהַצְמִ֗יחַ מֹ֣צָא דֶֽשֶׁא׃
verses.transliteration: lə·haś·bî·a‘ šō·’āh ū·mə·šō·’āh ū·lə·haṣ·mî·aḥ mō·ṣā ḏe·še
verses.literal: to satisfy the parched wasteland and make it sprout . . . with tender grass

verses.original: הֲיֵשׁ־ לַמָּטָ֥ר אָ֑ב א֥וֹ מִי־ ה֝וֹלִ֗יד אֶגְלֵי־ טָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hă·yêš- lam·mā·ṭār ’āḇ ’ōw mî- hō·w·lîḏ ’eḡ·lê- ṭāl
verses.literal: Does the rain have a father . . . Who has begotten the drops of dew

verses.original: מִבֶּ֣טֶן מִ֭י יָצָ֣א הַקָּ֑רַח וּכְפֹ֥ר שָׁ֝מַיִם מִ֣י יְלָדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mib·be·ṭen mî yā·ṣā haq·qā·raḥ ū·ḵə·p̄ōr šā·ma·yim mî yə·lā·ḏōw
verses.literal: From whose womb does the ice emerge Who gives birth to the frost from heaven

verses.original: כָּ֭אֶבֶן מַ֣יִם יִתְחַבָּ֑אוּ וּפְנֵ֥י תְ֝ה֗וֹם יִתְלַכָּֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kā·’e·ḇen ma·yim yiṯ·ḥab·bā·’ū ū·p̄ə·nê ṯə·hō·wm yiṯ·lak·kā·ḏū
verses.literal: when the waters become hard as stone and the surface of the deep is frozen

verses.original: הַֽ֭תְקַשֵּׁר מַעֲדַנּ֣וֹת כִּימָ֑ה אֽוֹ־ מֹשְׁכ֖וֹת כְּסִ֣יל תְּפַתֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: haṯ·qaš·šêr ma·‘ă·ḏan·nō·wṯ kî·māh ’ōw- mō·šə·ḵō·wṯ kə·sîl tə·p̄at·tê·aḥ
verses.literal: Can you bind the chains of the Pleiades or loosen the belt of Orion

verses.original: הֲתֹצִ֣יא מַזָּר֣וֹת בְּעִתּ֑וֹ וְ֝עַ֗יִשׁ עַל־ בָּנֶ֥יהָ תַנְחֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ṯō·ṣî maz·zā·rō·wṯ bə·‘it·tōw wə·‘a·yiš ‘al- bā·ne·hā ṯan·ḥêm
verses.literal: Can you bring forth the constellations in their seasons or lead out the Bear and her cubs

verses.original: הֲ֭יָדַעְתָּ חֻקּ֣וֹת שָׁמָ֑יִם אִם־ תָּשִׂ֖ים מִשְׁטָר֣וֹ בָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·yā·ḏa‘·tā ḥuq·qō·wṯ šā·mā·yim ’im- tā·śîm miš·ṭā·rōw ḇā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Do you know the laws of the heavens . . . Can you set their dominion over the earth

verses.original: הֲתָרִ֣ים לָעָ֣ב קוֹלֶ֑ךָ וְֽשִׁפְעַת־ מַ֥יִם תְּכַסֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ṯā·rîm lā·‘āḇ qō·w·le·ḵā wə·šip̄·‘aṯ- ma·yim tə·ḵas·se·kā
verses.literal: Can you command . . . the clouds so that a flood of water covers you

verses.original: הַֽתְשַׁלַּ֣ח בְּרָקִ֣ים וְיֵלֵ֑כוּ וְיֹאמְר֖וּ לְךָ֣ הִנֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: haṯ·šal·laḥ bə·rā·qîm wə·yê·lê·ḵū wə·yō·mə·rū lə·ḵā hin·nê·nū
verses.literal: Can you send the lightning bolts on their way Do they report to you Here we are

verses.original: מִי־ שָׁ֭ת בַּטֻּח֣וֹת חָכְמָ֑ה א֤וֹ מִֽי־ נָתַ֖ן לַשֶּׂ֣כְוִי בִינָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mî·šā- šāt̲ baṭ·ṭu·ḥō·wṯ ḥāḵ·māh ’ōw mî- nā·ṯan laś·śeḵ·wî ḇî·nāh
verses.literal: Who has put wisdom in the heart or . . . given understanding to the mind

verses.original: מִֽי־ יְסַפֵּ֣ר שְׁחָקִ֣ים בְּחָכְמָ֑ה וְנִבְלֵ֥י שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם מִ֣י יַשְׁכִּֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: mî- yə·sap·pêr šə·ḥā·qîm bə·ḥā·ḵə·māh wə·niḇ·lê šā·ma·yim mî yaš·kîḇ
verses.literal: Who has the wisdom to count the clouds Or who can tilt the water jars of the heavens

verses.original: בְּצֶ֣קֶת עָ֭פָר לַמּוּצָ֑ק וּרְגָבִ֥ים יְדֻבָּֽקוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṣe·qeṯ ‘ā·p̄ār lam·mū·ṣāq ū·rə·ḡā·ḇîm yə·ḏub·bā·qū
verses.literal: when the dust hardens into a mass and the clods of earth stick together

verses.original: הֲתָצ֣וּד לְלָבִ֣יא טָ֑רֶף וְחַיַּ֖ת כְּפִירִ֣ים תְּמַלֵּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ṯā·ṣūḏ lə·lā·ḇî ṭā·rep̄ wə·ḥay·yaṯ kə·p̄î·rîm tə·mal·lê
verses.literal: Can you hunt the prey for a lioness or satisfy the hunger of young lions

verses.original: כִּי־ יָשֹׁ֥חוּ בַמְּעוֹנ֑וֹת יֵשְׁב֖וּ בַסֻּכָּ֣ה לְמוֹ־ אָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yā·šō·ḥū ḇam·mə·‘ō·w·nō·wṯ yê·šə·ḇū ḇas·suk·kāh lə·mōw- ’ā·reḇ
verses.literal: when they crouch in their dens and lie in wait in the thicket

verses.original: מִ֤י יָכִ֥ין לָעֹרֵ֗ב צֵ֫יד֥וֹ כִּֽי־ יְלָדוֹ אֶל־ אֵ֣ל יְשַׁוֵּ֑עוּ יִ֝תְע֗וּ לִבְלִי־ אֹֽכֶל׃
verses.transliteration: mî yā·ḵîn lā·‘ō·rêḇ ṣê·ḏōw kî- yə·lå̄·ḏō ’el- ’êl yə·šaw·wê·‘ū yiṯ·‘ū liḇ·lî- ’ō·ḵel
verses.literal: Who provides food for the raven when its young cry out to God as they wander about for lack of food
